title: Bearer prefix and key lookup fail closed
detail: verifyRequestHeader rejects non-string headers and empty key identifiers before consulting activeKeys.
recommendation: Preserve the explicit MISSING_BEARER_PREFIX and UNKNOWN_KEY_ID reason codes.
why: Initial grade for unit.token-verifier confirming fail-closed behavior.

title: Non-finite or backward clock values corrupt rate-limit windows
detail: If nowMs is NaN or moves backward relative to entry.windowStartMs, the 60000ms reset condition fails to normalize the window.
recommendation: Validate Number.isFinite(nowMs) and clamp or reset when nowMs < entry.windowStartMs.
why: Cross-unit timestamp check identified unhandled clock skew and NaN inputs.

title: Null or malformed session entries throw TypeError during pruning
detail: Iterating records accesses record.expiresAtMs without guarding against null or undefined elements in the array.
recommendation: Check record && Number.isFinite(record.expiresAtMs) && Number.isFinite(nowMs) before comparing.
why: Defensive guard prevents a single malformed element from aborting pruning.
